whys: Pieter Levels on building startups alone

comments.author: dharma1
comments.story: Ask HN: Successful one-person online businesses?
comments.why: Pieter Levels on building startups alone
comments.text: Here's a recent talk by Pieter - [VIDEO] I think it's really good. Probably the best startup talk I've seen in a while. In my opinion, there are benefits to doing things alone, but you have to be able to learn a lot of things quick, have a lot of available time with few distractions, and be very focused and persistent. Cons: it's not as fun, and will probably take longer than working with people with specific talents.

comments.author: satvikpendem
comments.text: Check this video out where he goes over his past projects: [VIDEO] The truth is, out of the dozen or so products he made, only two had real commercial success, NomadList and RemoteOK. So there is survivorship bias present, he just kept trying until he succeeded.

comments.author: fouc
comments.story: Ask HN: How do you stay disciplined in the long run?
comments.why: Example of pushing through the pain to launch
comments.text: It's painful. It's supposed to be painful. Anyone that successfully launched kept working through the pain. Think of non-coders that taught themselves to code and launched webapps just by googling and facing the pain. [VIDEO]
